description:
MidnightHands
The Shadows You Fear, The Strength You Need

We are the silent warriors who emerge when the world sleeps, bound by a code forged in darkness and loyalty. Whether it’s slaying the fiercest monsters, conquering dungeons, or rising in PvP battles, MidnightHands strikes from the shadows—swift, decisive, and unstoppable.

In our clan, every member’s hand is guided by the will of the night. We may not be the loudest, but we are always the last to stand. Together, we shape our legacy with honor, power, and relentless pursuit of victory. We’re more than a clan; we are the night’s embrace, and we’ll rise when the clock strikes midnight.

Join us. Stand with us. Fear the dark.


We want to see you become stronger than what you believe is capable. 
Must be active in challenges help in guild raids.
